clips.title: The story
paras: The Venture Company is a notoriously ruthless goblin cartel focused on aggressive resource extraction, heavy industrial machinery, and logging. Unaligned with the major goblin ports like Booty Bay or Ratchet, the cartel strip-mines and clear-cuts territories across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms without regard for local populations or the natural world.

Led overall by Mogul Razdunk from afar, the Venture Company operates by a simple corporate philosophy: if it can be chopped down, drilled into, or blasted out of a mountain, they will exploit it. The cartel deploys some of the most advanced heavy machinery on Azeroth, including massive lumber-harvesting shredders, drilling rigs, and industrial refineries. Unlike traditional merchant houses that focus on shipping or retail, the Venture Company specializes in seizing raw resources by force, ignoring treaties, borders, and local sovereign rights.
